Websites and hosting.

Four simple services for South African businesses. Pick the one that fits, or ask us and we will help you choose.

Four ways we can help.

Starting fresh, modernising what you have, running a non-profit, or simply needing a better home for your website. There is a service for each one.

New website

A business that needs a new website.

A complete website made for your business, from the first design to the day it goes live.

  • Designed for your business
  • The pages we agree on
  • Works on phones and computers
  • Ready to go live
Enquire ↗

Website rebuild

A website that looks old or loads slowly.

We take your current website, give it a fresh look and make it faster, keeping the content that still works.

  • Fresh new look
  • Keep your content
  • Loads faster
  • Keep your web address
Enquire ↗

Non-profit website

Registered non-profits and community groups.

A complete website for non-profits and community groups, at a price that suits a tight budget.

  • Complete website
  • Made for your community
  • Donation details
  • Easy to update
Enquire ↗

Website hosting

A website you already have that needs a reliable home.

Hosting keeps your website online. We look after it, keep it secure, keep it fast and are here when something goes wrong.

  • Keeps your site online
  • Secure padlock included
  • Loads fast for visitors
  • Local help when needed
Enquire ↗

Not sure which one you need? Tell us about your business and we will point you in the right direction. Prices are on the pricing page.

Not sure which one fits?

Send us the address of your current site, if you have one, and what you need. We will tell you which service makes sense.

What happens next?

  1. We chat about your business and what you need.
  2. We tell you which service fits.
  3. You get a clear price and timeline in writing.
  4. Your website goes live and we keep it online.
